import numpy as np

def dp_sgd_gradient(gradient, clipping_norm, noise_scale):
    grad_norm = np.linalg.norm(gradient)
    clipped = gradient * min(1, clipping_norm / (grad_norm + 1e-10))
    noise = np.random.normal(0, noise_scale, clipped.shape)
    noisy_gradient = clipped + noise
    return noisy_gradient
